A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DataEnvGym work and contain 28 pages, including Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of the scientific text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original student-training experiments on GQA, MATH, LiveCodeBench, NaturalBench, and MnMs in Tables 2–6, plus generated-data analyses and the training-budget ablation in Appendices D–E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons, generated-data learning curves, and Table 8's data-versus-training-budget ablation.

M1.justification: The OPEN-ENDED, SKILL-LIST, and SKILL-TREE environments, agent modules, skill discovery, and explore/exploit procedures are identical in Section 2 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same tasks and datasets: GQA and NaturalBench for visual question answering, MATH, LiveCodeBench, and MnMs for tool use. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same Before Teaching and No State controls, oracle-versus-inferred skill comparisons, and GPT-4o-versus-GPT-4o-mini comparisons in Tables 2–6.

E3.justification: Reported student models, metrics, training budgets, validation-based selection, and dataset splits are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix B. Appendix E retains the same data-fraction and epoch controls.

E4.justification: Both retain identical analyses of skill difficulty and rarity, training dynamics, skill discovery quality, teacher quality, and qualitative examples. Appendices D–E preserve the generated-data accuracy analysis and additional-data versus additional-training ablation.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Both retain the same point-estimate reporting without added run counts, seed information, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative findings match, including appendix results. For example, Table 2's OPEN-ENDED With State accuracies remain 47.90 on GQA, 23.44 on MATH, and 18.91 on LiveCodeBench.

T1.justification: The state/action definitions and policy, training, evaluation, and data-generation equations are unchanged, as is Appendix E's training-budget calculation. No assumptions, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about a modular teacher-environment testbed, three levels of environment structure, feedback-conditioned data generation, and student improvement across four domains.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning feedback, curriculum constraints, skill difficulty and frequency, teacher quality, and the importance of fresh data are identical. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains identical hyperparameters, LoRA settings, prompts, model identifiers, resource costs, policy details, and split descriptions. Project and code access information also remains unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 4, Appendix A, and the references retain the same cited works and positioning relative to environment generation, knowledge distillation, skill discovery, and model weakness discovery.

P1.justification: Figure 1's caption changes 'data generation agent' to 'data generation agents.' v3 also adds the ICLR 2025 publication header and updates the arXiv version/date stamp; other prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds a conference-publication header on every page and updates the first-page arXiv stamp. Apart from the small Figure 1 caption edit, figures, tables, and body layout retain their design and placement.

improvement.justification: The publication header, updated arXiv stamp, and corrected plural in Figure 1 are cosmetic changes. Scientific content, empirical support, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
